lines.text: God swore by Himself, since no one was greater, that He would surely bless Abraham and multiply his descendants.
After waiting angrily, Abraham obtained the promise.
People swear by someone greater to end all argument, and God guaranteed His unchanging purpose with an oath.
Because God cannot lie, our hope is an anchor for the soul, light and quick, entering behind the curtain.
Jesus our forerunner entered on our behalf and became a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
